matched_queries: Employer responsibilities and worker rights: Applying union ballot thresholds, industrial-action mandates, picketing requirements or statutory union reporting rules.
Discover UK employment guidance for Trade Union Act 2016: repeal provisions. Task relevance is separate from current law, commencement and a need to edit.

passages.quote:
During the strike, workers and union reps may stand outside the place of work to explain why they’re striking and try to persuade others to join the strike. This is called picketing. It’s only lawful if it’s:

carried out near or at the strikers’ usual place of work (unless they are mobile workers or union reps for the workers involved)

done peacefully, without abusive or threatening behaviour

not breaking any criminal laws - for example, damaging property or obstructing roads

You may be able to take legal action if picketing is unlawful.
